changelog:
- 微信自动聊天技能，仅供学习，谨慎使用。

- Supports WeChat window management, contacts search, message sending/receiving, chat history extraction, and automated intelligent reply.
- Provides cross-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS), with detailed dependency and permission setup.
- Includes command-line interface for all main functions (start, activate window, search/send, get history, auto-process, etc.).
- Integrates with custom AI APIs for smart replies; key-based authentication required.
- Features robust region/config management, error handling, privacy safeguards, and logging/debugging options.
- Comprehensive technical and troubleshooting documentation included.
summary: 基于桌面端UI自动化的微信操作工具，支持Windows/macOS双平台，可实现微信窗口管理、联系人操作、消息收发、聊天记录提取及自动化智能回复.
